summary: This clinical trial compares a new weekly insulin called insulin icodec to a daily insulin called insulin glargine in adults with type 2 diabetes. Type 2 diabetes is a condition where the body does not use insulin properly, leading to high blood sugar levels. Researchers want to see how well switching from a daily insulin to the new weekly insulin helps reduce blood sugar. The trial includes 412 participants, is sponsored by Novo Nordisk A/S, and has the status Completed in Phase 3.
